metadata.description: Emitter catalog for the RF world model: maps each technology in channelization.json to a renderer, a priority tier, a default activity model and a plausible EIRP range.

tier_definitions.1: Protocol-faithful renderer: frame or burst structure, preambles/sync/pilots, standard symbol or chip rate, standard occupied bandwidth.
tier_definitions.2: Parametric renderer: correct band, channel raster, occupied bandwidth, power and duty cycle, with a generic modulation of the right family. No frame structure.
tier_definitions.3: Occupancy-only fallback for allocation rows with no technology metadata; labelled by allocated service.

metadata.eirp_note: EIRP values are plausible deployment ranges compiled from the rule parts and equipment classes named in channelization.json, not measured values. They are calibration parameters, to be adjusted against the measured power distributions in calibration_targets.
metadata.uplink_note: Cellular uplink is not a renderer. A downlink carrier emitter may be paired with separate user-equipment emitters carrying the uplink channel assignment, low EIRP and bursty activity.

fm_broadcast.description: Wideband FM with 19 kHz stereo pilot, 38 kHz DSB-SC difference channel, optional 57 kHz RBDS subcarrier.

atsc.description: ATSC 1.0 8-VSB with in-band pilot, or ATSC 3.0 OFDM, in a 6 MHz channel.

lte_downlink.description: LTE downlink frame: PSS/SSS, cell-specific reference signals, PBCH, PDSCH fill at a configurable load.

nr_downlink.description: 5G NR downlink: SSB burst set, CSI-RS, PDSCH fill; TDD pattern for n77/n78/n48.

wifi_ofdm.description: 802.11 PPDU (L-STF, L-LTF, L-SIG, payload) with CSMA/CA inter-frame spacing and backoff.

bluetooth.description: BLE advertising on channels 37/38/39 and hopping data channels; BR/EDR 79-channel hop sequence.

p25.description: P25 Phase 1 C4FM with frame sync and NID, or Phase 2 H-DQPSK two-slot TDMA.

dmr.description: DMR 4FSK, 2-slot TDMA with 30 ms slots and sync patterns.

analog_fm_voice.description: Narrowband FM voice at the emission designator's deviation, with speech-like modulating statistics.

am_voice.description: AM double-sideband voice (aeronautical 6K00A3E) with carrier and speech-like modulation.

paging_flex.description: FLEX 2-FSK/4-FSK frame structure, or POCSAG; simulcast at high power.

lora.description: LoRa chirp spread spectrum: preamble up-chirps, sync words, SFD down-chirps, payload symbols, at the standard chip rate.

adsb.description: 1090 MHz extended squitter: 8 us preamble plus 112-bit PPM, Poisson arrivals from a modelled aircraft population.

gnss.description: GPS L1 C/A: 1023-chip Gold codes at 1.023 Mchip/s, multiple satellites, received power set directly below the thermal floor.

pulsed_radar.description: Pulsed radar with configurable PRF, pulse width, intra-pulse modulation (none, LFM, NLFM) and mechanical scan modulation of the observed amplitude.

generic_fm.description: Parametric FM at the correct raster and deviation; TorchSig fm_modulator.

generic_fsk.description: Parametric FSK/GFSK at the correct symbol rate and raster; TorchSig fsk_modulator.

generic_ofdm.description: Parametric OFDM without pilots; TorchSig ofdm_modulator.

generic_pulse.description: Parametric pulse trains and pulse pairs.

generic_mixed.description: Draws from several modulation families for services where the mode varies (amateur, military UHF).

generic_service.description: Occupancy-only fallback for allocation rows with no technology metadata: a modulation family consistent with the allocated service, placed inside the row, labelled by service only.
